OCI Holdings Co Ltd Appoints New Chief Strategy Officer to Drive Renewable Energy Growth

Seoul—OCI Holdings Co Ltd, a leading player in South Korea’s renewable energy sector, has appointed Kim Ji-hoon as its new Chief Strategy Officer (CSO), marking a key move in the company’s ambition to expand its domestic and global footprint. The appointment, effective July 1st, was announced at the company’s headquarters in Seoul on Monday.

Kim Ji-hoon, a veteran executive with more than 20 years of experience in energy and infrastructure, joins OCI Holdings Co Ltd from Hanaro Green Solutions, where he spearheaded international expansion efforts. At OCI Holdings, Kim will be responsible for corporate strategy, mergers and acquisitions, and forging new partnerships as the company seeks to solidify its position amid a rapidly evolving energy landscape.

Chairman Park Min-soo commented, “Mr. Kim’s appointment signals our commitment to innovation and sustainable growth. His proven track record in scaling businesses and navigating complex market dynamics will be invaluable as we pursue our long-term vision of becoming Asia’s premier renewable energy provider.”

The renewable energy sector in South Korea has seen robust growth, with government targets aiming for renewables to account for 21% of the nation’s power generation by 2030. OCI Holdings, known for its solar module manufacturing and large-scale energy projects, has been at the forefront of this transition. Last year, the company reported a 12% increase in revenue, bolstered by strong demand for solar solutions and new project launches in Southeast Asia.

Industry analysts welcomed the appointment. “Strategic leadership is crucial as the sector faces increased competition and evolving regulatory environments,” said Lee Hye-rin, analyst at FutureValue Securities. “OCI Holdings’ decision to bring in an executive with both international and technical expertise demonstrates forward-thinking management.”

The Korea Renewable Energy Association also acknowledged the move, noting that attracting top talent is essential for Korean companies to maintain their competitive edge. Association spokesperson Choi Dong-hyun stated, “We expect Mr. Kim’s leadership to further strengthen OCI Holdings’ contributions to the national renewable energy agenda.”

Kim Ji-hoon expressed confidence in the company’s trajectory, saying, “I am honored to join OCI Holdings at such a pivotal time. I look forward to working with the team to unlock new growth opportunities and accelerate the transition to clean energy.”

OCI Holdings Co Ltd’s shares closed up 1.7% following the announcement.
